shortDescription: Bitcoin closed October at $77,430, but the anticipated “Uptober” rally did not materialize, analyst PlanB said. According to ChainCatcher, Bitcoin’s relative strength index (RSI) has remained above 50 for a third consecutive month, which PlanB says signals the start of a new bull market.

title: PlanB Says Bitcoin's RSI Above 50 for Three Months Signals New Bull Market
